+"""Request handlers."""
+
+import calendar
+import datetime
+import re
+
+from app.services import users
+
+_INVALID_DATE = (400, {"error": "invalid date"})
+
+_MONTHS = {name.lower(): number for number, name in enumerate(calendar.month_name) if name}
+_MONTHS.update({name.lower(): number for number, name in enumerate(calendar.month_abbr) if name})
+
+_ISO_RE = re.compile(r"(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})")
+_DAY_MON_RE = re.compile(r"(\d{1,2}) ([A-Za-z]{3}) (\d{4})")
+_MONTH_DAY_RE = re.compile(r"([A-Za-z]+) (\d{1,2}), (\d{4})")
+_DMY_RE = re.compile(r"(\d{2})/(\d{2})/(\d{4})")
+
+
+def _to_iso(year: int, month: int, day: int) -> str | None:
+    try:
+        return datetime.date(year, month, day).isoformat()
+    except ValueError:
+        return None
+
+
+def _parse_date(text: str) -> str | None:
+    match = _ISO_RE.fullmatch(text)
+    if match:
+        year, month, day = match.groups()
+        return _to_iso(int(year), int(month), int(day))
+
+    match = _DAY_MON_RE.fullmatch(text)
+    if match:
+        day, month_name, year = match.groups()
+        month = _MONTHS.get(month_name.lower())
+        if month is None:
+            return None
+        return _to_iso(int(year), month, int(day))
+
+    match = _MONTH_DAY_RE.fullmatch(text)
+    if match:
+        month_name, day, year = match.groups()
+        month = _MONTHS.get(month_name.lower())
+        if month is None:
+            return None
+        return _to_iso(int(year), month, int(day))
+
+    match = _DMY_RE.fullmatch(text)
+    if match:
+        day, month, year = match.groups()
+        return _to_iso(int(year), int(month), int(day))
+
+    return None
+
+
+def handle_normalize_date(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("date")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str):
+        return _INVALID_DATE
+    iso = _parse_date(raw.strip())
+    if iso is None:
+        return _INVALID_DATE
+    return 200, {"date": iso}
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
